integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic photoreal night scene shot on an anamorphic lens with 35mm film grain: a narrow back street in Istanbul in heavy rain at night, wet cobblestones glistening, a small tea house on the right with volumetric steam drifting out of its open doorway. Above the tea house door hangs a hand-painted neon sign that reads "DUR, BİR BAK!" in glowing red letters, and its mirrored reflection shimmers sharply in the wet cobblestones below. Beside the door stands a small chalkboard menu that reads "ÇAY 15 TL" in white chalk handwriting. Red neon and teal practical lights light the scene, wet asphalt reflections stretch toward the camera, and raindrops falling through the frame catch the red neon glow. The camera holds a medium-wide shot centred on the sign and pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. At about 2 seconds the neon sign flickers off and back on once, then stays steadily lit. At about 4 seconds a man in a dark trench coat walks in from the left along the wet street, slows beneath the sign and stops, rain beading on his shoulders. At about 9 seconds the focus racks at slow speed from the neon sign to his face as he glances up at the light; the sign falls into a soft red glow behind him. He stays under the sign until the end while steam curls past him. All on-screen text stays exactly "DUR, BİR BAK!" and "ÇAY 15 TL", spelled correctly with the dotted capital İ and the Ç cedilla intact, perfectly legible, stable and consistent for the whole video, with no morphing letters, no extra words and no subtitles.

overall_soundscape: Steady heavy rain patters on the cobblestones and on the tea house awning, the neon sign buzzes softly and crackles once during its flicker, the man's footsteps splash through shallow puddles, and a distant call to prayer echoes faintly across the rooftops.

non_diegetic_music: A low sustained synth hum at a slow tempo that gradually swells in volume toward the end.
